divergences.reading: mainline_qa IS readable by the Managed MCP identity. N01 claims an MCP identity cannot read per-person deliberation measurement; measured, it runs successfully. GRANTS.yaml S14 and the pack envelope both assert this is impossible. It is not. The read-only mainline_judge login this submission actually publishes refuses the same statement at SQLSTATE 42501 — measured on 2026-08-11 and recorded in evidence/deploy/judge-run.json under divergences — so the credential a judge is handed is the tighter of the two. That does not make N01 a pass, and it is not scored as one here.

verdict_reading: the pack does not round a divergence off. N01 asserts that an MCP identity cannot read mainline_qa; measured, it can. That is a real gap in this deployment's grants and it is recorded rather than closed by revoking a grant on submission eve.

credential_hygiene.assertion: no field in this file is credential-shaped
credential_hygiene.method: the serialised artefact was searched for (a) the live Managed-MCP service-account key verbatim, as a substring so a value embedded in a longer string is caught too, (b) any connection string whose userinfo still carries a password rather than the redacted form, and (c) any bare token of 24+ characters mixing upper case, lower case and digits — the shape a generated secret has. UUIDs are excluded by shape, not by an allowlist of values, which is why the cluster id survives the scan. bytes_scanned counts the artefact body as it was scanned, before this block was appended; after the write the file was re-read FROM DISK and scanned again, and a disagreement deletes the file rather than reporting a pass.
